text_blocks.snippet: Yes, COVID-19 infection can weaken the immune system. The virus can:

list.title: Suppress immune cells:
list.snippet: COVID-19 can directly suppress the activity of immune cells, such as T cells and B cells, making it harder for the body to fight off infections.

list.title: Cause an inflammatory response:
list.snippet: The virus can trigger an excessive inflammatory response, which can damage immune cells and lead to autoimmune reactions.

list.title: Reduce antibody production:
list.snippet: COVID-19 can reduce the body's ability to produce antibodies, which are essential for protecting against future infections.
